response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years experience requirement with nearly two decades of full-stack work, including strong recent alignment with the primary stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS) and directly relevant AI agent development experience with MCP tooling. A demonstrated testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, test frameworks, workshops) matches the role's quality focus. Gaps are minor: no explicit Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin, or Python exposure is listed, though the polyglot background suggests these are learnable quickly.
strengths: Deep full-stack TypeScript/Node.js and React experience at scale, including high-throughput systems
Hands-on AI agent infrastructure experience (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks)
Strong testing and software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, authored test libraries, taught courses)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience mentioned despite being primary stack items
Kotlin and Python absent from skills; Java experience appears dated
Significant career investment in niche DLang ecosystem rather than the role's core technologies

key_factors.factor: AI agent and MCP development experience
